paragraphs.text: Valtry is a legendary undine from Eldraine .

Valtry is a merfolk of Loch Larent mentioned in the tales of The Merfolk Who Walked . She had a great fascination with the surface world outside of Loch Larent and of the drywalkers who live outside of water. She collected items that fell into the lake and daydreamed about what life must be like outside the lake. She once found the skeleton of a human who ended up at the bottom of a loch further inspiring her curiosity.
